mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over a 5-year window, the 20-day forward return is not statistically different from zero when CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 10,000 jobs while UNRATE falls below 5%, signaling a strong labor market that depresses equity valuations and produces negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10,000 and UNRATE decreases below 5% in the same month
failure_condition: Over 10 years, the 60-day forward return is not significantly negative when both PAYEMS > +10k and UNRATE < 5% (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% for two consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate continued economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with no GDP acceleration, the 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 (after 2017 normalization) combined with a rise in FEDFUNDS above 1% signals supply-side weakness and a positive 5-day forward return as equities adjust to lower growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 1% in the same month
regime_hint: industrial contraction coupled with tightening policy
failure_condition: Over 3 years, the 5-day forward return is not significantly positive when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 1% (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as markets anticipate persistent tightening and reduce equity risk.
failure_condition: In regimes with no subsequent rate cuts, the 20-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4% followed by a 15% one-month increase in HOUST housing starts predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as recovery accelerates and risk appetite improves.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% then HOUST increases by >15% in the following month
failure_condition: Over 5 years, the 60-day forward return is not significantly positive when the UNRATE drop precedes the housing start surge (Granger causality failed).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS Treasury demand by over 10% in a month signals financial market stress and a negative 20-day forward return as investors retreat from equities.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >10% in the month
failure_condition: In non-stress regimes, the 20-day forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in INDPRO below its 2017=100 level without a corresponding drop in FEDFUNDS predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as supply contraction is not offset by policy tightening.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months and FEDFUNDS does not decline
regime_hint: supply contraction in a loose policy environment
failure_condition: Over 4 years, the 60-day forward return is not significantly positive when INDPRO falls and FEDFUNDS remains flat (interaction effect IC > 0.05).
